messages:
Anya Patel: Quick sync: need to pick which 3 models to prioritize for onboarding next quarter. Customers asking for better instruction-following and lower-latency/cheaper options. Thinking Mistral-instruct (16B), Llama2-70B-chat, Falcon-40B-instruct, and a quantized vicuna-13B variant. RICE vs impact/effort?
Rafael Gomez: Short: prioritize by customer delta + infra cost. Mistral = high impact + low cost. Llama2-70B = big impact but heavy infra -> lower reach.
Samir Khan: Agree. Quick RICE template: Impact(1-10), Reach(0-1), Confidence(0-1), Effort (person-weeks).
Noah Rivera: I'll run perf bench on hosted nodes tomorrow. Can we set perf gate: median p95 token-latency < 80ms at 2k context on our dedicated nodes? Also need mem/throughput targets.
Liz Chen: Top enterprise customers are explicitly asking for Llama2-70B in VPC. If we don't offer it, renewals/sales get blocked. That's serious.
Anya Patel: Ok proposed quick RICE calc (ballpark):
``` 
Model,Impact,Reach,Confidence,Effort -> RICE score 
Mistral-16B,9,0.6,0.8,4 -> 9*0.6*0.8/4 = 1.08 
Llama2-70B,10,0.5,0.6,12 -> 10*0.5*0.6/12 = 0.25 
Falcon-40B,7,0.4,0.7,6 -> 7*0.4*0.7/6 = 0.327 
Vicuna-13Q,6,0.8,0.7,2 -> 6*0.8*0.7/2 = 1.68 
``` 
Rafael Gomez: Vicuna-13Q looks highest by RICE but quality risk. It's a fast win for cost/latency.
Noah Rivera: Agree but must run evals on hallucination and instruction-following. I'll add automated evals to perf runs.
Samir Khan: Sequencing suggestion: 1) Vicuna-13Q (fast hosted + quantization profile); 2) Mistral-16B (quality-focused); 3) Llama2-70B (enterprise gated: private/Dedicated only rollout). Falcon can be a follow-up if we need another middle ground.
Anya Patel: Rollout policy idea: canary 5% traffic -> 25% -> full, with automatic rollback on perf or quality regressions. Gates: 
- Perf: p95 token-latency threshold + throughput per GPU node 
- Quality: eval pass rate >= 95% on core instruction set, no >5% regression on hallucination tests 
- Cost: cost per 1M tokens below internal target (TBD) 
- Ops: runbook + canary dashboard + oncall pager coverage
Liz Chen: Also add customer acceptance: for Llama2-70B, get a pilot approval from the top 2 enterprise customers before wide dedicated launch.
Samir Khan: Dev tasks: quant pipeline for Vicuna, Mistral optimization (kernel + kv cache), Llama memory profile + SD support for VPC.
Rafael Gomez: Risk notes: licensing/legal check for Llama variants, quantized model licensing for vicuna fork.
Noah Rivera: I'll drop initial bench results tomorrow noon and wire them into the catalog entry draft.
Anya Patel: Action items: 
- Noah: perf + eval runs (due: tomorrow EOD) 
- Samir: effort estimate + infra runbook for each model (due: Friday) 
- Liz: prioritize enterprise pilot outreach for Llama70 (reach out this week) 
- Rafael: legal/licensing check (ASAP)
Samir Khan: I'll estimate effort today.
Liz Chen: Reaching out now to two pilot customers :wave:
Noah Rivera: sending bench data to the thread once ready :rocket:
deploy-bot: Deployed canary metrics dashboard for model-onboard-catalog (link)
Anya Patel: Thanks all — we'll reconvene Friday to lock sequencing. :thumbsup:
